asked.item: how to get carousel from Videos templates to use brand details
brand details applied to the carousel

verdict.reason: The help pages give the exact steps for carousels made from Videos templates: set the primary brand, pick a template, enter a prompt, and enable "Use brand kit".

steps.text: Set up your brand in Settings > My Brand and mark the brand you want as Primary, since the primary brand is used by default.
For carousels, go to Videos > Create New Video and select a template.
Enter a prompt, because the brand context is not applied without one.
Turn on "Use brand kit" before you generate; the toggle starts off, and when it is on it adds the primary brand's context to the prompt-based generation.
